candidates.name: Ag/Cu interface-density engineering
candidates.hypothesis: Controlling the spatial distribution of Ag/Cu interfaces may influence ethylene selectivity.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Prepare catalysts with systematically varied Ag/Cu interface density while controlling composition, loading, and testing conditions.
candidates.key_uncertainty: Whether interface density can be varied independently of morphology and composition.

supporting_observations.source_location: supporting_information:Table S1, page S-27; Figure S18, page S-23

candidates.scientific_warning: Reported literature performance is not a prediction for this proposed design.

candidates.name: Porosity-controlled Cu-Ag catalyst
candidates.hypothesis: Modifying pore morphology in Cu-Ag catalysts may influence local transport and C2 selectivity.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Prepare comparable Cu-Ag catalysts with different pore structures and measure ethylene and ethanol selectivity under matched operating conditions.
candidates.key_uncertainty: Whether changes in selectivity arise from porosity, surface composition, or restructuring.
candidates.scientific_warning: Reported literature performance is not a prediction for this proposed design.

candidates.name: Ag nanoparticle distribution on Cu frameworks
candidates.hypothesis: Controlling Ag nanoparticle distribution on Cu-containing framework nanosheets may change ethylene selectivity.
candidates.proposed_experiment: Vary Ag nanoparticle dispersion while monitoring framework stability, catalyst composition, and product selectivity.
candidates.key_uncertainty: Whether the original framework structure persists under CO2 reduction conditions.
candidates.scientific_warning: Reported literature performance is not a prediction for this proposed design.
